lesson_title: The Friday the Float Came Up Short
hook_text: The tuck-shop float is short — and here's the scary part: even the guy holding it can't prove he didn't take it.
clip_script: One learner runs the whole tuck shop. Bongani takes the money, gives out the chips, keeps the float in his blazer, promises to write it down later. Friday: float short. Did he steal? Here's the disaster — NOBODY CAN KNOW. Not the teacher. Not the class. Not even Bongani. No records, no counting, one pocket for everything: honesty and theft leave identical evidence. Now replay it. Zanele on the cash box. Bongani on stock. Karabo ticking every sale. Two people count the box together at closing. Same kids, same chips — but now the box matches the sheet or it doesn't, and everyone knows by Friday break. And when it balances? Bongani's honesty is PROVABLE. That's internal control: not suspicion — protection.
visual_style: Chalkboard-style replay: chaotic break-time rush freezes, rewinds, and replays with three labelled roles and a cash box that visibly balances against a tick sheet.
mood: Suspenseful then relieving — a mystery that dissolves into a system.
pacing: Slow ominous setup, sharp rewind moment, brisk rule-by-rule replay, warm landing line.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and learn to spot the gap in any business.
